title: Anthropic prompt caching does not work for user message when set with providerOptions
body:
### Description

Looks like the function (convertPartToLanguageModelPart) (https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/9197aa5b18c50668118b9f2b9551239d4ca3b06c/packages/ai/core/prompt/convert-to-language-model-prompt.ts#L214) only relies on experimental_providerMetadata and not on providerOptions.

```
if (part.type === 'text') {
    return {
      type: 'text',
      text: part.text,
      providerMetadata: part.experimental_providerMetadata,
    };
  }
```

### Code example

So in my code this does not work -
```
part.providerOptions = { anthropic: { cache_control: { type: 'ephemeral' } } };
```

While this is ok -

```
part.experimental_providerMetadata = { anthropic: { cache_control: { type: 'ephemeral' } } };
```


### AI provider

Anthropic

### Additional context

Trying to use prompt caching

linked_prs.title: fix (ai/core): forward providerOptions for text, image, and file parts

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue concerns prompt management and LLM provider integration (Anthropic), specifically how prompt caching is handled via providerOptions versus providerMetadata. It directly references provider-specific parameters and prompt behaviors, which are agent system components per the taxonomy.
